evidence.title: TRG Data Center Campus — HOU2 Brochure
evidence.excerpt: TRG's 2026 campus brochure says HOU2 construction is underway and separately reports 24 MW of HOU2 utility power and 30 MW of confirmed campus power from CenterPoint.

metadata.campus_scope_as_reported: 10-acre TRG-owned parcel; 30 MW confirmed power from CenterPoint; 2 data centers
metadata.status_wording_as_reported: HOU2 construction underway, phase one delivery in Q4’26
metadata.status_scope: The current brochure's explicit underway wording supports one generic HOU2 project-level under_construction observation as of retrieval. It does not establish a more specific physical substage or completion percentage.
metadata.capacity_scope: One planned campus-level grid_connection_mw row preserves the confirmed 30 MW campus power from CenterPoint, and one planned HOU2 project-level grid_connection_mw row preserves the explicitly labeled 24 MW facility utility power. The 24 MW facility scope is nested within and non-additive to the 30 MW campus scope.
metadata.capacity_stage_guardrail: Confirmed and utility wording does not prove either value is installed, energized, available for current draw, or consumed. Both are retained as planned grid-connection scope rather than current load.
metadata.economic_example_as_reported: 12 MW IT load -> $0.045/kWh savings across 105M annual kilowatt-hours
metadata.economic_example_guardrail: The 12 MW, 105 million annual kWh, and price figures are an illustrative savings example, not HOU2's declared design IT capacity, measured energy, contracted tariff, or current consumption. They create no normalized claim.
metadata.forecast_guardrail: The quarter is a forward-looking delivery window, not an exact date and not evidence of completion, commissioning, operation, or current load.
metadata.campus_identity_advisory: The source diagram and text place HOU1 and HOU2 on one two-data-center Spring Cypress campus. HOU2 remains a project/facility inside that campus; no parcel geometry, external auto-merge, or unique-site claim is created.
metadata.owner_role_scope: TRG is normalized only as campus owner because the brochure explicitly calls the ten-acre parcel TRG-owned. No project owner, operator, developer, tenant, customer, utility, or contractor role is inferred.
metadata.centerpoint_role_guardrail: CenterPoint is retained in the exact power-source wording. The document does not explicitly label a role field, so no separate utility role tag is created.
metadata.classification_guardrail: High-density, HPC, GPU, cloud, storage, network, dedicated, hyperscale, cooling, and uptime language describes capabilities, examples, or HOU1 history and creates no HOU2 workload or operating-model observation.
metadata.energy_guardrail: Apart from the excluded economic example, the brochure provides no measured annual energy, current draw, project-specific PUE, renewable share, or operating consumption.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Publisher layouts and diagrams, satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, and analyst geolocation contribute nothing to normalized claims.
